line: If you're in L.A. and you never know what to do this weekend, I built an app for that.
note: Quick and bright, to a friend, sure of himself.

line: It's called PXI, and this is everything on in L.A. this weekend.
note: Quick and easy, a little pleased with himself.

line: I made it because every Friday I had five tabs open, just to find one thing to do.
note: Quick, talking to a friend, still a bit annoyed about it.

line: This Friday there's a dinner with strangers in Echo Park. I didn't know that existed, and I made the app.
note: Quick and amused, then dry, laughing at himself a little.

line: Saturday there's a party that still hasn't said where it is. I respect that.
